definitions.explanation: A hard pointed growth on the head of cattle, goats, etc.
The branched horn of a deer.

notes:
{角|つの} refers to horns or antlers on animals.

KANJI READINGS:
The kanji {角|かく} has multiple readings with different meanings:
- {角|つの}: horn, antler (animal body part)
- {角|かど}: corner (of street, building)
- {角|すみ}: corner (of room, inside space)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {角|つの}が{生|は}える: for horns to grow
- {角|つの}が{落|お}ちる: for antlers to shed
- {一角|いっかく}: one horn; a corner (of a place)

IDIOMS:
- {角|つの}を{出|だ}す: to get angry (lit. "to show one's horns")
- {角|つの}を{折|お}る: to yield, give up stubbornness
- {角|つの}を{隠|かく}して{牛|うし}を{殺|ころ}す: to cause more harm while trying to hide a small flaw
